source_text: wrǽstlere, es ; m. A wrestler :-- Wrǽstlere luctator (- ur, MS. ), Wrt. Voc. ii. 50, 37. [Iacob speleð wrastlare, A. R. 374, 4. Wrestelare luctator, . Prompt. Parv. 533.] Cf. wraxlere.
